generator_candidate.candidate: Framework RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) plus Convert.ToHexString; exactly32 uppercase ASCII hexadecimal characters
generator_candidate.why: One bounded framework RNG call and built-in bijective encoding; no copied random algorithm, rejection sampler or truncated native recovery generator.
generator_candidate.input_candidate: Accept exactly32 ASCII uppercase hex characters for this candidate. Any case/separator-friendly alternative must be explicit, versioned and entropy-preserving; do not inherit TOTP canonicalization or permissive Unicode normalization.
generator_candidate.status: Recommendation for technical review only. User consent to the view/download is not selection of this format, production set count or generator deployment compliance.

verifier_candidate.mechanics: Pinned native Identity PasswordHasher in explicit IdentityV3 mode; no custom PBKDF2/crypto or default raw RecoveryCodes store.
verifier_candidate.binding: Hash an unambiguous bounded recovery-purpose/profile/owner/set-generation context plus canonical code, or another reviewed equally explicit binding. The generic user parameter is not owner binding. Keep operation/code plaintext out of logs, context receipts and stable status projections.
verifier_candidate.new_profile_header_constraints: For a supported new recovery V3 profile, require the exact framework-generated marker/PRF/salt/subkey lengths and an allowlisted encoded iteration value before verification. A16-byte salt and32-byte subkey produce61 binary bytes/84 base64 characters; this is a technical format constraint, not a selected production work factor.
verifier_candidate.cost_hazard: Native VerifyHashedPasswordV3 uses the cost and sizes embedded in a stored verifier. Constructor IterationCount is not a maximum verify cost. Validate the bounded supported header before native invocation; reject excessive/malformed/legacy/unsupported values without KDF work.
verifier_candidate.no_downgrade: No IdentityV2, weaker PRF, lower-cost retry or alternate store on malformed/profile mismatch. Migration/rehash policy, if ever needed, must be explicit; no existing recovery-code migration is inferred.

required_finite_bounds: CodesPerSet is an owner input constrained to1..MaximumCodesPerSet from a concrete closed supported profile; the browser cannot select either count.

Creation has at most the supported count of hashes plus a bounded collision allowance; verification has at most the supported candidate count. No unbounded Distinct/regenerate loop or unrestricted per-account/history scan.

Trusted supported costs constrain worst-case creation/verification work to bounded hashCalls times iterationCost; bound concurrent hash requests and queued work. Count, cost and concurrency cannot be independent unbounded settings.

Input bytes, framed context fields, verifier encoding length, set candidates, response bytes and download bytes have explicit checked maxima; no allocation based on unchecked stored or browser-provided lengths.

Check cancellation/deadline before and after native synchronous hash calls, but do not claim cancellation interrupts one PBKDF2 call. Actual per-call cost must already be bounded; elapsed checks alone are insufficient.

Profile id/native version, required immutable policy references and origin/scope/current operation must resolve to implemented allowlisted combinations. Missing or unsupported inputs fail closed without production defaults.

Public nonfunctional fixture measurements must justify the selected count/cost/concurrency/time limits before implementation qualification. This review does not invent production rate, latency, proof lifetime or retention values.
source_validity: Generate/Replace carries current recovery policy/profile and exact set/lifecycle/operation validity into the existing shared last decision point after all awaited owner/proof/source work; proof-assurance currentness alone cannot stand in for recovery-owner currentness.

Consume requires the actual same active owner transaction and trusted recovery-case authorization; recheck case/policy/set validity at its final owner commit frontier after verification. No existing strong-factor session requirement is added by assumption.
Clarify lifecycle changes versus individual usage changes so replacement invalidation and distinct-code concurrency have the selected semantics, not accidental whole-set version conflicts.

consent_delta.verified: Actual current bytes decoded as UTF-8 and LF-normalized hash independently matched. Root recorded authorized L01-L03 plus same-view optional single local download. This supersedes only the old pending visible/admission condition, not technical profiles or production/session/replacement inputs.
